source_verification.claim: Hypophosphatasia has low alkaline phosphatase activity, defective mineralization, ALPL/TNSALP dysfunction, and characteristic premature tooth loss.
ALPL variants reduce TNSALP; inorganic pyrophosphate accumulates and impairs bone/tooth mineralization.

second_answer_attack.strongest_alternative: Osteogenesis imperfecta or a rickets/osteomalacia disorder.
second_answer_attack.resolution: Low-trauma fractures alone are nonspecific, but repeatedly low age-adjusted alkaline phosphatase plus premature loss of primary teeth with intact roots strongly identifies hypophosphatasia. Nutritional rickets and X-linked hypophosphatemia generally have elevated ALP, while osteogenesis imperfecta does not explain persistent low ALP and this dental pattern.
